text:
At handover, the shift coordinator read your email, and we are sorry to hear about the trouble you had moving through the pet check process and the way it affected your trip. You were expecting a smoother handoff for your companion animal, clearer guidance from our team, and a better response when things started to go wrong.

I am sorry this landed on your side of the counter. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is set up to keep travel steps clear, calm, and consistent, and when that does not happen we treat it as a service miss. I have reviewed the notes from the desk and the issue appears to have come from a break in routine communication, not from any refusal to help. That does not make the experience easier for you, and I understand why you were frustrated.

For travel with Aurelia Skyways, the passenger coordinator is supposed to give the required steps in plain language and keep the handoff moving without extra stress. That includes checking paperwork, confirming the carrier setup, and making sure the animal is treated with care at each stage. We expect our staff to flag any concern early, explain what is happening, and stay with the case until it is resolved. If that did not happen, we need to own it.

I have already passed your complaint to the lead coordinator so the desk can review where the process slipped. We also use reports like yours to tighten our routine work and make sure the next traveler does not face the same confusion. If you are traveling again with a pet, the desk can help you through the steps before you arrive so there are no surprises at check-in. That does not undo what happened, but it should help us do better next time.

Thank you for taking the time to write in. We know a companion animal is part of the family, and we should handle that responsibility with more care than you received. Companion Animal Travel Desk
